last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 fresh long-COVID self-management topics, all classified as non-prescription candidates. The final query set returned 166 unique PubMed PMIDs, 166 article IDs requested, 166 fetched article records, and 163 abstracts available for inspection because three fetched records lacked abstracts. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 39978856, 41213124, 37725376, 38528512, 41253410, 38824899, 35236727, 36191860, 35489367, 40110757, 37722791, 42384384, 35901492, 38416635, 40848897, 42577968, 38071990, 39072958, 39840178, and 41277895. Twenty PubMed references were added across 20 new entries. New entries cover exercise rehabilitation, resistance exercise, pulmonary rehabilitation, telerehabilitation, inspiratory and respiratory muscle training, singing-based breathing, mindfulness, acceptance and commitment therapy, cognitive rehabilitation, smell training, photobiomodulation, tDCS with cognitive training, probiotics, synbiotics, vitamin D, omega-3, and psychoeducation. The existing breathing-therapy-long-covid-null entry was linked for the breathing topic. Pacing, energy conservation, graded exercise, occupational therapy, yoga, meditation, CBT, sleep intervention, speech-language therapy, acupuncture, and massage were screened out because the selected PubMed records were protocols, reviews, non-topic-specific studies, or lacked a retained numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect. No build error or new targeted comparison/effect/line warning remained. Three truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 30-, 32-, and 48-participant trials.
